title: Full Incident Reconstruction
story: Black Falcon Bank has declared a major security incident. Multiple systems show suspicious activity, but individual alerts provide only fragments of what occurred. The SOC has preserved network, authentication, endpoint, DNS and application telemetry from the incident window. Reconstruct the intrusion, identify the attacker's path through the environment and determine whether sensitive banking data left the network.
objective: Perform an end-to-end incident reconstruction using multiple telemetry sources. Establish the attacker's origin, compromised identity, lateral movement path, persistence or command-and-control activity, staged data and final exfiltration destination.

questions.label: Reconstruct the internal lateral movement path
What technique provided operating-system command execution?
Identify the archive prepared for exfiltration
Identify the final exfiltration destination IP
At what time did the first confirmed hostile activity begin?
